name: diff_patch
description: Generate unified diffs between files or apply patches. Useful for code review and incremental edits.

manual.overview: Use diff_patch to compare two files and see exactly what changed, line by line. Produces unified diff format. Useful for code review and understanding changes before committing.
tips: Use this before committing to review exactly what changed.
Lines starting with + are additions, - are removals.
For git-tracked changes, prefer 'git diff' instead.
edge_cases: Both files must exist for diff action.
Binary files will produce meaningless output.
Very large files may produce very long diffs.
